shortDescription: New Zealand’s central bank is more likely to wait until December before raising interest rates again, Assistant Governor Karen Silk said, according to Bloomberg.Silk made the comment on the timing of the Reserve Bank of New Zealand’s next move.

title: GEOPOLITICS | RBNZ Seen Waiting Until December for Next Rate Hike
